summary: Specifies the messages of the Internet Control Message Protocol for IPv6, used to report errors and carry diagnostic information. Tools such as ping depend on it. It was a draft standard, replaced by RFC 4443.

eli5.summary: If a letter cannot be delivered, the post office sends a note saying why. ICMPv6 is how internet routers send such notes for the newer addresses.
